# Listen to Stryker’s Kevin Lobo and Spencer Stiles on Bloomberg Intelligence Vanguards of Healthcare podcast


##### 28-Aug-2026


#####


Stryker Chair and CEO Kevin Lobo and President and COO Spencer Stiles recently sat down with Bloomberg’s Matt Henriksson to discuss how our culture and disciplined approach to M&A supports innovation, strengthens our portfolio and fuels our market-leading growth.


[Listen to the podcast episode](https://open.spotify.com/episode/5xBHQtxTIBzwc8tqAeYXbZ?si=35239ebaf97e4e88)
